snippet.title: Ghost Scout - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Ghost Scout demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4157550/Ghost_Scout/

Identify invisible ghosts using mundane and strange objects. Find the Anchor without getting killed, reveal the ghosts true form and attempt to get out alive.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/DGGtACxwrX

I'm very happy to announce Ghost Scout and I hope you enjoy this trailer!

When I got the idea for how I would create this trailer (with the short real-life sections) I really wasn't sure how it would turn out, but I'm glad I went in this direction and tried something new!
